name: Fashion Empire
description: Stitch a premium apparel empire together: cotton fields, denim mills and department-store shelves. Designer jeans carry a brand premium, but only high-income shoppers reach for $130 trousers — price too high and the aisle empties.

goals.description: Operate at least 2 farms — cotton is the foundation of the chain.
Operate at least 2 factories — weave denim and cut jeans in-house.
Put designer jeans on a shelf — the brand is not real until a customer can buy it.
Sell 30% of the designer jeans bought in Metropolis (trailing three months), where high-income shoppers cluster.
Earn $36M of net income in total — premium margins have to carry the business after depreciation, interest and tax.
